excerpt: College of Communication, Architecture + The Arts Creative Forces at Work CARTA helps you craft your vision as an interdisciplinary college at Miami’s only public research university. Learn from award-winning faculty in nationally-ranked programs, all in one of the country’s most vibrant and creative cities. Creating the Future How CARTA Shapes Humanity and Innovation CARTA is where we help you begin to craft your vision. As an interdisciplinary college that develops the next generation of creators, we offer unique learning experiences within Miami’s only public research university. You can learn from and work with award-winning faculty, in nationally-ranked, accredited programs in the heart of one the country’s most vibrant, diverse, and creative cities. Shaping Humanity Through CARTA’s Creativity and Innovation Each of the disciplines housed in CARTA informs the way we think, interact, and relate with each other. These disciplines make us “human” in every sense of the word. CARTA inspires and feeds creativity, problem-solving skills, and resiliency. Sparking dialogue through our design, visual and performing arts, and communication. Devising ways to improve the world for the next generation. Launch Your Future with CARTA We are your launching point to what’s next. From researching the impacts of climate change to augmented reality to immersive concert experiences and mesmerizing theater productions; From the seagrass to the sawgrass- our faculty will help you develop a meaningful future. It’s your future: Create it. Leadership Opportunities CARTA is now accepting applications for internal faculty leadership opportunities. These roles support strategic initiatives and provide professional growth in academic administration. Learn more and apply today. Spotlight Nomination We are looking out for our CARTA Creative Forces at Work! Do you have an achievement you’re proud of? Whether you’re a current student, alumni, or faculty, share your story with us for an opportunity to spotlight your contributions to the community through a feature article, spotlight interview, social media highlight, and more showcasing opportunities.
